en.t: “Mm, I was thinking of growing it out.”

units.source_text: 岛村一边抚摸刚剃过胡须的青色胡茬，

en.t: Shimamura stroked the bluish stubble where he had just shaved,

units.source_text: 一边思忖着：在自己的嘴角上掠过一道漂亮的皱纹，使平和的脸显得更加隽秀英俊，

en.t: thinking that a fine crease ran past the corner of his mouth, making his calm face look even more handsome and refined,

units.source_text: 说不定驹子正是看中了这一点？

en.t: and perhaps Komako had been drawn to just that?

units.source_text: “你真是，一除去脂粉，你的脸看上去就像用剃刀刮过一样。”

en.t: “Really, whenever you take off your powder, your face looks as if it has just been scraped with a razor.”
